notes: New: Added DASH stream support alongside HLS. Improved: Fixed a bug where some TV channels with plain (non-HLS) streams were being forced through the wrong parser and failing to play. Streams with a permanently unsupported format now fail fast with a clear message instead of retrying for ~30 seconds first. Reduced background battery use: the equalizer's real-time audio analysis now samples less often, and the periodic background station refresh skips itself when the battery is low.
